# FBInk

`fbink.h`, `libfbink.a` and `../../bin/fbink` are built, unmodified, from
[FBInk](https://github.com/NiLuJe/FBInk) by NiLuJe, version
v1.25.0-543-g886f25f1 (commit
[886f25f1](https://github.com/NiLuJe/FBInk/commit/886f25f1)), with image and
TrueType support, for the Kobo (ARM, static).

FBInk is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or
later (see [LICENSE](../../LICENSE)). Its source is at
https://github.com/NiLuJe/FBInk. `build-fbink.sh` at the top of this repo
rebuilds these files from a checkout:

    ./build-fbink.sh path/to/FBInk-checkout
